guidance: Define a Business Continuity Plan classifying workloads by resilience level: Multi-AZ HA for most applications, and cross-region DR for critical workloads. Match each workload's strategy to its RTO/RPO. A common pattern is Multi-AZ HA with continuous cross-region data replication and an on-demand CloudFormation template for recovery. DR also enables point-in-time recovery, useful against ransomware or accidental corruption. Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery to set up and test DR scenarios.
how_to_check: Is a BCP documented with workloads classified by resilience level (AZ vs. region)? Are RTO/RPO defined per workload and matched to the appropriate strategy? Is data replicated continuously to a second region for critical workloads? Have DR scenarios been actively tested? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
